summary.title: The Vault Heist and the Harrison Ford of Oresk
summary.synopsis: The party teleports directly into the vault of RC3 inside the First House of Oresk, ransacks it for powerful magic items, then uses Rampart's still-smoldering heart to melt through the vault door. After sneaking through the facility's residential terrarium — discovering Kharkov's tragically paternal relationship with Rampart and Sub-Zero — they ambush Kharkov and his ally the Slipseer. Dawn steals "the gun" off Kharkov's hip using split-timeline precognition, Divex blows up the Slipseer, and the session ends mid-fight with Kharkov bloodied and his divine spellcasting disrupted by the gun's Divinity Leech.
key_beats: Dawn scouts the vault of RC3 after the party teleports in; the pedestal where the gun should be is empty. The party hides the orb behind a shelf and takes a long rest, with Henrik using Legendary Medic to clear his drained condition.

The party emerges and ransacks the vault, Divex identifying a haul of legendary items: Shield of the Unified Legion, a Luck Blade with one Wish, a 9th-level Wand of Slaying, Rod of Cancellation, Silhouette Cloak, Final Blade, Greater Robe of the Archmagi, Codex of Destruction and Renewal, and more — distributed among the party.

Kharkov's voice comes over the loudspeaker: he's lifted the lockdown, blamed the party for Rampart's death and the beacon's destruction, and branded them terrorists with flyers going out across Oresk.

Levmir disguises the party as generic Oreskians; they realize the vault door only opens from the outside and prop Rampart's heart-bearing corpse against it to melt through the adamantine over several hours.

The party sneaks through the facility past the fungus-choked Eschatology Division toward the residences, finding a terrarium dome with three identical homes. Searching them reveals a locket with portraits of young Rampart and Sub-Zero as children, and a fairy tale book — suggesting Kharkov raised them.
Dawn (still disappeared/invisible) sneaks 75 feet toward two silhouettes at the end of a hallway — Kharkov and the Slipseer. The party decides to ambush rather than parley.

Initiative rolled; Kharkov opens with a 100-damage force eye-laser on Levmir. Combat escalates with heavy exchanges; Levmir uses Exploit Vulnerability and discovers weakness to Sovereign Stealer (confirming Kharkov's vampire nature).

Dawn uses precognition to split timelines and attempts a thievery steal of the gun from Kharkov's hip — succeeding in the second timeline with a 51 plus Practice Makes Perfect, ripping the weapon away.

Divex destroys the Slipseer (a CR 21 Sovereign Dragon) with a grimoire-enhanced implosion spell; her death effect deals 100-200 damage to the party. Henrik falls, but Levmir saves himself with a vampiric self-Harm as a Mortal Herald of Nox.

Divex channels All Is One, One Is All through the Codex to grant the party regeneration 20 for four rounds; Levmir repeatedly interrupts Kharkov with attacks of opportunity that cancel his actions on hits.

Dawn invests in and fires the gun — Divinity Leech — at Kharkov; he fails the Will save and becomes fatigued and unable to cast divine spells, severely crippling his toolkit. The session pauses at the end of Divex's turn with Kharkov bloodied and the fight ongoing.
items: Locket (portrait of young Rampart and Sub-Zero)
summary.cliffhanger: The fight with Kharkov is paused mid-combat at the end of Divex's turn. Kharkov is bloodied, fatigued, and his divine spellcasting is disrupted by the gun's Divinity Leech — but he's still standing and fighting back. The party must finish the encounter next session.
